title: Pope Pius XII informs Allies of the craft

tellings.quote: Through discrete channels, the Pope quietly informed the Allies about the craft's existence and storage location.

And then you have the Magenta crash probably being held by the Vatican as well or or at least under the knowledge I think it was held at the Soratte bunker which was outside of Rome. But it was the information about it was back channeled through Pope Pius the 12th to FDR.
tellings.difference: Names the storage place as the Soratte bunker outside Rome and names FDR as the person receiving the back-channel.
tellings.link_reason: Both say Pope Pius XII quietly told the Allies (here FDR) about the Magenta craft and where it was stored.

as_told.title: Magenta crash held at Soratte bunker, back-channelled via Pius XII to FDR
as_told.place_text: Magenta and Soratte bunker near Rome, Italy

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that around the 1930s and 1940s a crashed craft, which he calls the Magenta crash, was held in Italy, possibly by the Vatican, perhaps at the Soratte bunker outside Rome. According to Michels, Pope Pius XII, head of the Catholic Church at the time, quietly passed word of the craft and where it was stored to the Allies, in one telling to US President Franklin D. Roosevelt. If true, it would mean the Church knew of a recovered craft before the famous American cases.
